children: RNS Number : 1664X  JPMorgan European Grwth & Inc PLC  01 October 2026
Information disclosed in accordance with DTR 6.1.13
The Directors of JPMorgan European Growth & Income plc have declared the following dividend:

A third interim dividend of 1.36 pence per ordinary share, for the year ending 31 March 2027, will be paid on 4 December 2026 to shareholders on the register at the close of business on 9 October 2026. The ex-dividend date will be 8 October 2026.
The Company offers the option for shareholders to invest their dividend in a Dividend Reinvestment Plan ("DRIP"). For details on the DRIP, please contact the Company's Registrar, Computershare.
The last day for DRIP election is 13 November 2026.
